newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: VENEZUELA SETS 60 BLN BOLIVAR TEM BILL AUCTION WED.
newsitem.headline: VENEZUELA SETS 60 BLN BOLIVAR TEM BILL AUCTION WED.

text.p: The Central Bank of Venezuela announced for Wednesday morning a 60 billion bolivar auction of 177-, 269- and 358-day "monetary stabilization," or TEM, bills at nominal interest rates of up to 23.97 percent.

The bank said it would offer 40 billion bolivars worth of 177-day bills with a nominal interest rate of 22.67 percent, 10 billion bolivars of 269-day bills at 23.32 percent and 10 billion bolivars of 358-day bills at 23.97 percent.
At its auction last week, the central bank sold 53.4 billion bolivars worth of 177-, 269- and 358-day bills with yields of 22.67, 24.49 and 25.70 percent respectively.
